children: Volkswagen _p.DE> on Friday slashed its outlook, flagging €10 billion ($11.5 billion) in one-off items related to its stake in luxury sportscar maker Porsche
, provisions for job cuts and a weak Chinese market.
Shares in Europe's largest automaker fell 5.6% on the news.
The German-based group now expects a profit margin of 1% at the most in 2026, having previously guided for 4.0% to 5.5%.
